correctness.rationale: Exact forward equations imply a telegraph wave equation. The explicit conjugation gives H=g²[-d²/dz²+nu²-nu(nu+1)sech²z]; Darboux factorization with positivity of the residual partner excludes all extra bound eigenvalues, Weyl gives the continuum threshold, and quadratic temporal roots and mass conservation give the gap and remove a spurious zero-mode decay. Independent symbolic conjugation and finite-difference spectra agree for three gradients; finite numerical tests are not used as infinite proofs.
